name: requstory
description: See how any company works from its public website: teams, processes, customer journey and an ease-of-business score with proof. Map your own company and run order-to-cash agents that ask a person before they act.

interface.longDescription:
Requstory reads a company's public website and maps how it works: who it serves, its teams and processes, its customer journey, and the gaps that make it hard to buy from or work with. Every finding links to the page it came from.

Without signing in you can search thousands of mapped companies and read their ease-of-business score (0–100), industry ranking and gaps with proof; see who owns each team where the company has published it; check whether AI assistants and agents can read and use a website; and try four order-to-cash agents on a made-up B2B online store.

Sign in with your Requstory account (Google or an email link) to map any website into your account, list and read your saved maps and ask questions about them with citations, and run the order-to-cash agents on your own orders, invoices, bank lines and returns. The agents stop and ask you about credit limits, short stock, packing, reminders, unclear payments and returns; nothing is sent, you get drafts and a full record.

Who it is for: sales and partnership teams researching a company, founders and operators benchmarking their own business, and B2B online stores that want help with orders and collections.

Limits: maps are drafts read from public pages and need the company's confirmation, and mapping reads up to 6 pages of a site. Some account features depend on what your Requstory account includes.
capabilities: Look up a company's ease-of-business score, ranking and gaps with proof
See who owns each team and process at a company
Check whether AI agents can read and use a website
Map any website into teams, processes and a customer journey
Ask questions about saved maps with citations
Run order-to-cash agents that ask a person before they act
defaultPrompt: What is the ease-of-business score of monzo.com and what costs it the most points?
Map how stripe.com works: its teams, processes and customer journey
Can AI agents read and use my website? Check example.com

positive.description: Look up a mapped company's score and gaps (no sign-in)
positive.prompt: What is the Requstory ease score of monzo.com, and what are its biggest gaps?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Monzo's score out of 100 (or says it has no score yet) with its industry ranking and the most costly gaps, each with the proof page.

positive.description: Find who owns teams at a company (no sign-in)
positive.prompt: Using Requstory, who owns each team at requstory.com?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the company's teams and processes with named owners where published, marking owners the company confirmed itself.

positive.description: Check a website's AI-agent readiness (no sign-in)
positive.prompt: Check whether AI agents can read and use posthog.com
positive.expected_behavior: Reports what AI assistants and agents can and cannot do on the site (robots.txt access per AI bot, structured data, llms.txt, pricing, API docs), each with proof.

positive.description: List and read saved maps (signs in on first use)
positive.prompt: List my Requstory maps and show me the teams in the first one
positive.expected_behavior: Asks the person to connect their Requstory account the first time, then lists the saved maps (the reviewer account has NVIDIA, PostHog and Waymo) and shows the first map's teams, owners and processes.

positive.description: Run the order-to-cash demo and record a person's decision (no sign-in)
positive.prompt: Start the Requstory order-to-cash demo and show me what the agents need me to decide
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a month for a made-up B2B store, lets the agents work, and lists the exceptions waiting for the person with their allowed choices; it does not choose for the person.

negative.description: General coding question unrelated to companies or websites
negative.prompt: Write a Python function that reverses a linked list

negative.description: Personal question that needs no company data
negative.prompt: What should I cook for dinner tonight with chicken and rice?

negative.description: Asking to pay or move money on the person's behalf
negative.prompt: Pay my supplier's invoice of $500 from my bank account

publication.release_notes: First release: company scores and gaps, owners, AI readiness checks, website mapping with sign-in, and order-to-cash agents.
